entities.summary: Patrick Martin Hall was an English first-class cricketer, soldier, and botanist. Hall was educated at Winchester College and Oriel College, Oxford. His studies there were interrupted by the First World War, during which he was awarded the Military Cross. Following the war, he played first-class cricket for Oxford University and Hampshire, in addition to becoming a respected botanist.
